status: [D] STAGED — an executable form of a criterion the owner already ruled. It invents no test.
what_this_is: The adjudication procedure for emergence claims. Given a claim that phenomenon P at register D_{n+1} is a genuine crossing rather than a reduction, this decides — one crossing at a time.

why_it_is_assembly_not_invention.the_criterion_already_exists: 05_COSMOLOGY/03_FORMAL_SYSTEM/48_THE_BOUNDARY_CROSSINGS_AND_THE_MU_CRITERION.md:159-164, ruled by the owner 2026-07-29 (HR-1 Option C): 'A crossing is a candidate mu iff the higher description is NOT formally reducible to the frozen lower one.'
why_it_is_assembly_not_invention.the_field_contract_already_exists: Same file :196-200 — a candidate must supply boundary, saturation statistic, threshold, novelty test, recovery, prediction and kill (the KSC-05 contract).
why_it_is_assembly_not_invention.what_was_missing: An executable form, and an application. The corpus has the procedure and has run it to verdicts; what it has never done is fill a crossing at [A]/[B].
why_it_is_assembly_not_invention.why_this_matters: Anderson 1972 owns the asymmetry (reduction does not imply construction). Laughlin & Pines 2000 restate the denial. Neither adjudicates PER CROSSING. That is the only unoccupied ground, and it is unoccupied because it is hard, not because nobody thought of it.

step_0_type_the_arrow.test: Is the claimed crossing a LIFT (D_n -> D_{n+1}, carrying a forgetful map back down), or an OUTWARD arrow (adjoining a boundary or dimension to a given space)?
step_0_type_the_arrow.why: :168-172 — outward arrows are not lifts, carry no forgetful map, and are not mu-candidates at all. Compactification and complexification are outward.
step_0_type_the_arrow.on_outward: HALT. Not a mu-candidate. This is not a failure of the claim; it is a type correction.
step_0_type_the_arrow.worked_kill: adjoining infinity_P to R does not create D2 — R -> RP^1 is type-T/O, a boundary crossing, not a lift (:180-183, KSC-22 vindicated)

step_1_the_reducibility_test.test: Is the higher description FORMALLY REDUCIBLE to the frozen lower one?
step_1_the_reducibility_test.verdict_if_reducible: NOT a mu. 'Where formal equivalence or reduction accounts for the claimed novelty, the crossing is not a mu, however much apparatus it appears to add.'
step_1_the_reducibility_test.note: This is the load-bearing test. It replaced the retired type-D criterion because dim_R killed 4 of 5 mu's and the fibre test killed 0 of 5 — NEITHER DISCRIMINATED. A criterion that kills everything or nothing is not a criterion.

step_2_the_seven_fields.note: KSC-05. All seven required; a candidate missing any one is incomplete, not refuted.

step_3_the_size_fence.test: Is the claim resting on the higher space being LARGER?
step_3_the_size_fence.ruling: Size does not decide. ':187-189' — after HR-1 the size fact no longer decides mu_1; reducibility does. The collection of relations on X is P(X x X), strictly larger than X x X by Cantor — and largeness alone proves nothing.
step_3_the_size_fence.also: For a continuous f, its graph is homeomorphic to X. A graph by itself proves no strong emergence.

current_verdicts_as_recorded.note: The corpus's own state, quoted not inferred, from 48:145-152. These are mu-candidacy verdicts. They are NOT the same question as TEA-01 mapping — conflating the two is an error this file exists partly to prevent.
current_verdicts_as_recorded.mu_2: FAILS — the load-bearing step was reducibility
current_verdicts_as_recorded.separate_and_unfilled: TEA-01 mapping to any natural mu remains [C] PER CROSSING — 06_ONTOLOGY/14_THE_TEN_EMERGENTIST_ANSWERS_2026_08_24.md:558. Filled rows at [A]/[B]: zero of five.

verdict_vocabulary.NOT_A_CANDIDATE: step 0 — the arrow is outward, not a lift
verdict_vocabulary.REDUCED: step 1 — formal reduction accounts for the claimed novelty
verdict_vocabulary.INCOMPLETE: step 2 — one or more of the seven fields is unsupplied
verdict_vocabulary.STANDS: survives steps 0-3; a live mu-candidate, NOT a proved crossing
verdict_vocabulary.FILLED: STANDS plus a TEA-01 mapping at [A] or [B]. Currently held by nothing.

what_this_procedure_cannot_do: It cannot prove strong emergence. STANDS means not-yet-reduced, which is not the same as irreducible.
It cannot fill a crossing by being run. Filling requires the TEA-01 mapping, which is mathematics, not adjudication.

It does not decide the Wigner question. That claim needs 'emergent from D1 therefore reducible to D1' — the constructionist converse Anderson denied in 1972 — and this procedure would return REDUCED or INCOMPLETE on it, not a dissolution.

kills.dies_if: the criterion or the seven fields are shown to be authored here rather than quoted from 48 and KSC-05
48:145-152 is shown to say something different, or a later signed ruling changed them
a TEA-01 crossing row at [A] or [B] is exhibited
a STANDS verdict is cited as evidence of strong emergence — the vocabulary exists precisely to prevent that
